title: Haki — Your rules before you trade
Your rules.
Before your emotions.
scenes.label: MEET HAKI
scenes.speech: Your rules. Before your emotions. Meet Haki.

title: Start with your plan.
scenes.label: 01 / GET STARTED
scenes.speech: After installing Haki, select Get Started.

title: Make the rules yours.
scenes.label: 02 / YOUR RULES
scenes.speech: Make these rules your own. Edit a rule, or add another. Then continue.

title: Protect your platform.
scenes.label: 03 / YOUR PLATFORM
scenes.speech: Find your trading platform and turn protection on. Allow site access when your browser asks.

title: Choose your rhythm.
scenes.label: 04 / YOUR REMINDER
scenes.speech: Choose how often Haki appears. Here, we're using every new trading tab.

title: Keep your rules close.
scenes.label: 05 / FINISH SETUP
scenes.speech: Want your rules on every new tab? Turn this on, then finish setup.

title: Pause. Read. Confirm.
scenes.label: 06 / BEFORE YOU TRADE
scenes.speech: Open your trading platform. Haki brings up your rules. Read and check each one, then select Ready to Trade.

title: Your checklist. Done.
scenes.label: READY FOR YOUR SESSION
scenes.speech: Confirmed. Now you're back to your trading workspace.

title: A calmer new tab.
scenes.label: YOUR DAILY REMINDER
scenes.speech: And your new tab keeps those same rules within reach.
